### Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Biotech]** **Inhibrx advances OX40 agonist INBRX-106 in HPV-positive head and neck cancer** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/08/inhibrx-inbrx-106-ox40-immunotherapy-head-and-neck-cancer-hpv-positive/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * Inhibrx reported positive preliminary clinical proof-of-concept for INBRX-106, a hexavalent agonist targeting OX40, in patients with HPV-positive head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
  * The readout marks a rare positive signal for the OX40 co-stimulatory pathway, following a history of clinical failures across various biopharma drug-development programs.

* **Maladaptive smooth muscle Piezo1 mechanotransduction drives gut aging and motility loss** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.02.748183)
  * Inducible smooth muscle cell (SMC) deletion of the mechanosensitive ion channel Piezo1 in aging mice prevented age-associated slowing of intestinal transit and loss of muscle contractility.
  * Mechanistically, Piezo1 couples tissue stiffness to Ca²⁺/calcineurin/NFAT signaling, triggering a switch from a contractile to synthetic SMC phenotype and driving wall stiffening.

* **PTPRF identified as a nutrient-responsive checkpoint in hepatic and pancreatic β-cell metabolism** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.03.748858)
  * Spliced XBP1 transcriptionally represses receptor protein tyrosine phosphatase PTPRF under metabolic stress.
  * Loss of PTPRF enhanced insulin signaling, promoted actin filament organization, reduced hepatic steatosis, and boosted glucose-stimulated insulin secretion in pancreatic β-cells.

* **Electrochemical EV liquid biopsy platform yields >90% diagnostic accuracy for MASH** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.02.26362088)
  * An electrochemical immunoassay utilizing gold nanoparticle-modified electrodes quantified liver-derived extracellular vesicle (EV) surface markers (S100A11, TNF-α, and TGF-β1).
  * The combined composite EVMASH score achieved 100% accuracy in a training cohort and >90% accuracy in an independent clinical validation cohort, distinguishing MASH from non-MASH liver conditions.

* **Recirculating CD103⁺ ex-tissue-resident memory T cells track atopic dermatitis remission** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.02.26362057
  * Single-cell multi-omics profiling of blood and skin during IL-4R inhibition revealed that AD remission is accompanied by memory Treg expansion and a rapid decrease in skin-recirculating CD103⁺/CD4⁺ ex-tissue-resident memory T (Trm) cells within 3 days of treatment.

* **Tumor-intrinsic NSUN2 drives immune evasion in lung adenocarcinoma** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42706582/)
  * Investigators identified that the RNA methyltransferase NSUN2 orchestrates an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment in lung adenocarcinoma via an m⁵C-HDAC8-CCL5 signaling axis.

---

### Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **[Biotech]** **Roivant’s mosliciguat achieves 56.3% reduction in PVR in Phase 2 PH-ILD study** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/08/roivant-mosliciguat-pulmonary-hypertension-interstitial-lung-disease-results/?utm_campaign=rss) | [BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2097264156260917731)
  * Inhaled soluble guanylate cyclase (sGC) activator mosliciguat met its primary endpoint in the Phase 2 PHocus trial for pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD).
  * Treatment achieved a statistically significant, placebo-adjusted pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR) reduction of -56.3% (p < 0.0001) at Week 16.

* **[Biotech]** **Beam Therapeutics updates Phase 1/2 clinical data for BEAM-302 in AATD** [BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2097264725981601812)
  * Beam presented updated clinical findings from its ongoing Phase 1/2 trial evaluating BEAM-302, an in vivo liver-directed base editing candidate, in patients with alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency (AATD).

* **[Big Pharma]** **Sanofi evaluates HER2×CD3×CD28 trispecific engager SAR443216 in Phase 1/1b trial** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42705861/)
  * First-in-human Phase 1/1b study results for SAR443216, a trispecific T-cell engager targeting HER2, CD3, and the co-stimulatory domain CD28, demonstrated manageable safety and systemic T-cell activation in relapsed/refractory HER2-expressing solid tumors.

* **[Big Pharma]** **J&J’s nipocalimab demonstrates safety in Phase 2 maternal trial for severe HDFN** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.org/42705868/)
  * Pediatric follow-up data from an open-label Phase 2 study evaluating maternal administration of the anti-FcRn antibody nipocalimab demonstrated favorable infant outcomes and reduced need for intrauterine transfusions in high-risk hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn (HDFN).

* **Anaerostipes caccae probiotic strain CLB101 reduces GI symptom burden in Phase 2 study** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.03.26362186)
  * In a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial (n = 93) in overweight adults, 28-day administration of butyrate-producing *Anaerostipes caccae* CLB101 was well-tolerated and produced significant improvements in the Gastrointestinal Symptom Rating Scale (GSRS) composite score.

* **Parcel-guided rTMS targeting DLPFC-sgACC circuit yields high remission in depression study** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.03.26362155)
  * Individualized, structural MRI-guided rTMS specifically targeted to cortical parcel 46 of the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex demonstrated high clinical efficacy in 15 patients with treatment-resistant depression.
  * Baseline anti-correlation strength between parcel 46 and the subgenual anterior cingulate cortex significantly predicted subsequent clinical response.

---

### Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **Novartis drug del-desiran fails Phase 3 HARBOR trial in myotonic dystrophy** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/08/novartis-del-desiran-myotonic-dystrophy-harbor-trial-failure-neuromuscular/?utm_campaign=rss) | [BioStocks / X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2097266656158380368)
  * Investigational RNA-targeting therapy del-desiran failed to reach primary efficacy endpoints in the pivotal HARBOR study for myotonic dystrophy type 1.
  * The collapse follows recent Phase 3 HORIZON study failures and safety holds across eight active CAR-T clinical trials following three patient deaths.

* **Digitally enhanced continuous gait monitoring reduces sample size in Phase 3b MS trials** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.03.26361524)
  * Post-hoc analysis of the Phase 3b CONSONANCE study (n = 667) in multiple sclerosis showed that integrating smartphone-based high-frequency gait metrics into composite confirmed disability progression (cCDP) reduced required trial sample sizes by 24.9% at Week 48.
  * The digital endpoint achieved equivalent statistical power 24 weeks earlier than standard clinical cCDP alone (Week 72 vs. Week 96).

---

### Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Biotech]** **Revolution Medicines’ Rasonque faces post-approval reimbursement delays** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/08/pancreatic-cancer-patients-caught-beween-fda-drug-approval-insurance-coverage/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * Following FDA approval of Revolution Medicines' pancreatic cancer treatment Rasonque, access has been hampered by administrative coding delays and insurer coverage policies, leaving patients unable to obtain the approved drug.

---

### Business & Strategy

* **[Biotech]** **BrainChild Bio launches with $116M Series A for pediatric CNS CAR-T pipeline** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/brainchild-pediatric-brain-tumors-car-t/829463/)
  * Seattle Children’s Hospital spin-out BrainChild Bio completed a $116 million financing round to advance clinical CAR-T therapies specifically engineered for children with rare CNS cancers.
  * The platform utilizes direct central nervous system administration to deliver engineered immune cells while attempting to minimize central neurotoxicity.

---

### Public Health & Policy

* **Regression discontinuity study protocol launched to test shingles vaccine impact on incident dementia** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.03.26362052)
  * A natural experiment protocol leveraging the OpenSAFELY platform in England will evaluate the comparative effectiveness of live-attenuated Zostavax and recombinant Shingrix on long-term incident dementia risk across national electronic health records.

* **Two-pathogen dynamical modeling establishes population-level inhibition between influenza and RSV** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.03.26362151)
  * Epidemiological modeling of multiplex viral hospitalization data from Valencia, Spain (2010–2020) demonstrated significant mutual viral interference between influenza and respiratory syncytial virus, modifying population transmission dynamics during concurrent winter surges.

* **Stochastic modeling estimates basic reproduction number of R₀ = 2.30 for Andes Hantavirus** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.31.26361797)
  * Integration of historical outbreak data into network models calculated a baseline human-to-human reproduction number of R₀ = 2.30 (95% CI: 1.33–3.27) for Andes virus, underscoring the necessity of immediate contact tracing to suppress Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome outbreaks.

* **Relaxed dosing intervals for maternal syphilis treatment show non-inferior outcomes** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.03.26361028)
  * A multi-jurisdictional US study (2018–2023) in pregnant women with late latent syphilis found no statistically significant difference in congenital syphilis rates when benzathine penicillin G doses were administered at 6–8 day intervals versus the strictly mandated 9-day cutoff.

---

**Worth watching:** The divergent paths for sGC activation in pulmonary vascular disease — Roivant’s strong Phase 2 PHocus readout for inhaled mosliciguat contrasts sharply with broader setbacks in cardiovascular drug development, making its upcoming Phase 3 design in PH-ILD critical to watch.
